name: Botryodiplodin
description: Botryodiplodin (CAS 27098-03-9 ) is a sesquiterpene aldehyde produced by the fungus Botryodiplodia theobromae. It is primarily sourced as a pharmaceutical research intermediate and bioactive compound for agrochemical studies. In pharmaceutical research, botryodiplodin is investigated for its antimicrobial and cytotoxic properties against various cell lines. Agrochemical researchers evaluate it as a potential lead compound for crop protection formulations. These formulations specifically target various fungal pathogens in agricultural settings. Analytical laboratories use it as a reference standard for mycotoxin detection and quantification in food safety testing protocols. Botryodiplodin is supplied as a high-purity solid, typically in milligram to gram quantities for research use.
